description: This file defines the 'maintenance' interface and related functions for interacting with etcd cluster maintenance operations, including alarm management, defragmentation, status checks, snapshot handling, leader transfer, and version downgrade.

classes.name: SnapshotResponse
classes.description: Represents the response from a snapshot stream, including header info, snapshot data stream, and version.

classes.name: maintenance
classes.description: Implementation of the Maintenance interface, handling gRPC communication with etcd server for maintenance operations.

classes.name: snapshotReadCloser
classes.description: Wraps a ReadCloser with context-aware read method for snapshot data streams.

methods.name: NewMaintenance
methods.description: Creates a new Maintenance client instance from a given Client.

methods.name: NewMaintenanceFromMaintenanceClient
methods.description: Creates a Maintenance client from an existing pb.MaintenanceClient.

methods.name: AlarmList
methods.description: Retrieves all active alarms from the etcd cluster.

methods.name: AlarmDisarm
methods.description: Disarms a specified alarm or all alarms if none specified.

methods.name: Defragment
methods.description: Releases wasted space on a specific etcd member.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Gets the status of a specific etcd endpoint.

methods.name: HashKV
methods.description: Returns a hash of the key-value store at a specific revision.

methods.name: SnapshotWithVersion
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot with version info.

methods.name: Snapshot
methods.description: Provides a stream reader for a snapshot of etcd.

methods.name: logAndCloseWithError
methods.description: Logs errors during snapshot streaming and closes the pipe.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Writes snapshot response blob data to the pipe writer.

methods.name: Downgrade
methods.description: Requests a cluster version downgrade, verification, or cancellation.
